spans.s: वड् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. वंडते) 1. To surround, to envelop; 2. to divide, to partition.
वड् (II) vt. 10U (pres. वंडयति-ते) To share, to divide.
वाड् vi. 1Ā (pres. वाडते) To bathe.
वडभि f. 1. A turret, a balcony, a top-room; 2. the wooden of a roof, धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वडभयः संदिग्धपारावताः Vikr.iii.
वडभि f. 1. A turret, a balcony, a top-room; 2. the wooden of a roof, धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वडभयः संदिग्धपारावताः Vikr.iii.
वडवा f. 1. A mare; 2. the nymph Aśvinī (who assumed the form of a mare to have sexual intercourse with the sun); 3. a woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste; 4. a female slave; 5. a prostitute, a harlot.
वाडव (I) m. 1. Submarine fire; 2. a Brāhmaṇa.
वाडव (II) n. A collection of mares.
वडवा-अग्नि, -अनल m. submarine fire.
वाडव-अग्नि, -अनल m. the submarine fire.

वाडव-अग्नि, -अनल m. the submarine fire.
वडवा-मुख m. 1. submarine fire; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
वडा f. A kind of cake.
वडिश n. The same as बडिश q.v.
वड्र a. (f. ड्रा) Large, great.

वाडवेय (I) m. A bull.
वाडवेय (II) m. du. The two Aśvins.
वाडव्य n. A multitude of Brāhmaṇas.
